mapper.sql: request_row.request_id, request_row.request_no, request_row.title, request_row.purpose, request_row.status, request_row.requested_by_user_cd, request_row.requested_by_user_id, request_row.requested_by_user_nm, request_row.requested_dept_cd, request_row.requested_dept_nm, request_row.partner_company_id, request_row.partner_company_code, request_row.partner_company_name, request_row.approver_user_cd, request_row.approver_user_id, request_row.approver_user_nm, TO_CHAR(request_row.distribution_start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS distribution_start_date, TO_CHAR(request_row.distribution_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS distribution_end_date, TO_CHAR(request_row.submitted_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS submitted_at, TO_CHAR(request_row.decided_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS decided_at, request_row.decided_by_user_cd, request_row.decided_by_user_id, request_row.decided_by_user_nm, request_row.decision_comment, TO_CHAR(request_row.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS created_at, TO_CHAR(request_row.updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM docs_distribution_request_recipient recipient_count WHERE recipient_count.request_id = request_row.request_id)::integer AS recipient_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT item_count.object_id) FROM docs_distribution_request_item item_count WHERE item_count.request_id = request_row.request_id)::integer AS document_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM docs_distribution_request_item item_count WHERE item_count.request_id = request_row.request_id)::integer AS item_count, GREATEST(request_row.distribution_end_date - CURRENT_DATE, 0)::integer AS remaining_days
mapper.select: INSERT INTO docs_distribution_request ( request_no, title, purpose, status, requested_by_user_cd, requested_by_user_id, requested_by_user_nm, requested_dept_cd, requested_dept_nm, partner_company_id, partner_company_code, partner_company_name, approver_user_cd, approver_user_id, approver_user_nm, distribution_start_date, distribution_end_date, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( 'DREQ-' || TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') || '-' || LPAD(NEXTVAL('docs_distribution_request_no_seq')::varchar, 8, '0'), #{request.title}, #{request.purpose}, 'DRAFT', #{actor.userCd}, #{actor.userId}, #{actor.userNm}, #{actor.deptCd}, #{actor.deptNm}, #{partner.partnerCompanyId}, #{partner.companyCode}, #{partner.companyName}, #{approver.approverUserCd}, #{approver.userId}, #{approver.userName}, #{request.distributionStartDate}::date, #{request.distributionEndDate}::date, #{actor.userCd}, #{actor.userCd} ) RETURNING request_id

WITH source_file AS (
SELECT 'SW'::varchar AS object_type, info.object_id, file_info.file_no::varchar AS file_no, info.sw_no AS material_no, COALESCE(info.sw_nm, '') AS material_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(info.tree_cd, ''), NULLIF(info.business_type_cd, '')) AS tree_cd, COALESCE(file_info.org_file_nm, file_info.file_nm, '') AS original_file_name, CASE WHEN BTRIM(COALESCE(file_info.file_size::text, '')) ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN LEAST( BTRIM(file_info.file_size::text)::numeric, 9223372036854775807::numeric )::bigint ELSE 0 END AS file_size FROM docs_sw info JOIN docs_sw_file file_info ON file_info.object_id = info.object_id WHERE info.object_id = #{objectId} AND file_info.file_no::varchar = #{fileNo} AND COALESCE(info.deleted_yn, 'N') = 'N'
SELECT 'SW_SUB'::varchar AS object_type, info.object_id, sub_file.file_no::varchar AS file_no, info.sw_no AS material_no, COALESCE(info.sw_nm, '') AS material_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(info.tree_cd, ''), NULLIF(info.business_type_cd, '')) AS tree_cd, sub_file.org_file_nm AS original_file_name, COALESCE(sub_file.file_size, 0)::bigint AS file_size FROM docs_sw info JOIN docs_sw_sub_file sub_file ON sub_file.parent_object_id = info.object_id WHERE info.object_id = #{objectId} AND sub_file.file_no::varchar = #{fileNo} AND COALESCE(info.deleted_yn, 'N') = 'N' AND COALESCE(sub_file.use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y'
SELECT ''::varchar AS object_type, ''::varchar AS object_id, ''::varchar AS file_no, ''::varchar AS material_no, ''::varchar AS material_name, ''::varchar AS tree_cd, ''::varchar AS original_file_name, 0::bigint AS file_size WHERE FALSE
) SELECT source_file.*, item_tree.tree_nm, parent_tree.tree_cd AS parent_tree_cd, parent_tree.tree_nm AS parent_tree_nm, effective_label.grade_cd, effective_label.grade_nm, TO_CHAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS snapshot_at FROM source_file LEFT JOIN docs_sw_tree item_tree ON item_tree.tree_cd = source_file.tree_cd LEFT JOIN docs_sw_tree parent_tree ON parent_tree.tree_cd = item_tree.upper_tree_cd LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT label.grade_cd, grade_order.grade_nm FROM docs_file_security_label label LEFT JOIN docs_security_grade grade_order ON grade_order.grade_cd = label.grade_cd WHERE label.object_id = source_file.object_id AND ( (label.object_type = source_file.object_type AND label.file_no IN (source_file.file_no, '*')) OR (source_file.object_type = 'SW_SUB' AND label.object_type = 'SW' AND label.file_no = '*') ) ORDER BY grade_order.grade_level DESC NULLS LAST, CASE WHEN label.object_type = source_file.object_type AND label.file_no = source_file.file_no THEN 0 WHEN label.object_type = source_file.object_type AND label.file_no = '*' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END LIMIT 1 ) effective_label ON TRUE

WITH document_file AS ( SELECT 'SW'::varchar AS object_type, info.object_id, main_file.file_no::varchar AS file_no, info.sw_no AS material_no, COALESCE(info.sw_nm, '') AS material_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(info.tree_cd, ''), NULLIF(info.business_type_cd, '')) AS tree_cd, COALESCE(main_file.org_file_nm, main_file.file_nm, '') AS original_file_name, CASE WHEN BTRIM(COALESCE(main_file.file_size::text, '')) ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN LEAST(BTRIM(main_file.file_size::text)::numeric, 9223372036854775807::numeric)::bigint ELSE 0 END AS file_size, 0 AS file_kind_order FROM docs_sw info JOIN docs_sw_file main_file ON main_file.object_id = info.object_id WHERE info.object_id = #{value} AND COALESCE(info.deleted_yn, 'N') = 'N' UNION ALL SELECT 'SW_SUB'::varchar AS object_type, info.object_id, sub_file.file_no::varchar AS file_no, info.sw_no AS material_no, COALESCE(info.sw_nm, '') AS material_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(info.tree_cd, ''), NULLIF(info.business_type_cd, '')) AS tree_cd, COALESCE(sub_file.org_file_nm, '') AS original_file_name, COALESCE(sub_file.file_size, 0)::bigint AS file_size, 1 AS file_kind_order FROM docs_sw info JOIN docs_sw_sub_file sub_file ON sub_file.parent_object_id = info.object_id WHERE info.object_id = #{value} AND COALESCE(info.deleted_yn, 'N') = 'N' AND COALESCE(sub_file.use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y' ) SELECT document_file.object_type, document_file.object_id, document_file.file_no, document_file.material_no, document_file.material_name, document_file.tree_cd, item_tree.tree_nm, parent_tree.tree_cd AS parent_tree_cd, parent_tree.tree_nm AS parent_tree_nm, document_file.original_file_name, document_file.file_size, effective_label.grade_cd, effective_label.grade_nm, TO_CHAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS snapshot_at FROM document_file LEFT JOIN docs_sw_tree item_tree ON item_tree.tree_cd = document_file.tree_cd LEFT JOIN docs_sw_tree parent_tree ON parent_tree.tree_cd = item_tree.upper_tree_cd LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT label.grade_cd, grade_order.grade_nm FROM docs_file_security_label label LEFT JOIN docs_security_grade grade_order ON grade_order.grade_cd = label.grade_cd WHERE label.object_id = document_file.object_id AND ( (label.object_type = document_file.object_type AND label.file_no IN (document_file.file_no, '*')) OR (document_file.object_type = 'SW_SUB' AND label.object_type = 'SW' AND label.file_no = '*') ) ORDER BY grade_order.grade_level DESC NULLS LAST, CASE WHEN label.object_type = document_file.object_type AND label.file_no = document_file.file_no THEN 0 WHEN label.object_type = document_file.object_type AND label.file_no = '*' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END LIMIT 1 ) effective_label ON TRUE ORDER BY document_file.file_kind_order, document_file.file_no

WITH catalog_file AS ( SELECT 'SW'::varchar AS object_type, info.object_id, main_file.file_no::varchar AS file_no, info.sw_no AS material_no, COALESCE(info.sw_nm, '') AS material_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(info.tree_cd, ''), NULLIF(info.business_type_cd, '')) AS tree_cd, COALESCE(main_file.org_file_nm, main_file.file_nm, '') AS original_file_name, CASE WHEN BTRIM(COALESCE(main_file.file_size::text, '')) ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN LEAST(BTRIM(main_file.file_size::text)::numeric, 9223372036854775807::numeric)::bigint ELSE 0 END AS file_size FROM docs_sw info JOIN docs_sw_file main_file ON main_file.object_id = info.object_id WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(info.tree_cd, ''), NULLIF(info.business_type_cd, '')) = #{value} AND COALESCE(info.deleted_yn, 'N') = 'N' UNION ALL SELECT 'SW_SUB'::varchar AS object_type, info.object_id, sub_file.file_no::varchar AS file_no, info.sw_no AS material_no, COALESCE(info.sw_nm, '') AS material_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(info.tree_cd, ''), NULLIF(info.business_type_cd, '')) AS tree_cd, COALESCE(sub_file.org_file_nm, '') AS original_file_name, COALESCE(sub_file.file_size, 0)::bigint AS file_size FROM docs_sw info JOIN docs_sw_sub_file sub_file ON sub_file.parent_object_id = info.object_id WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(info.tree_cd, ''), NULLIF(info.business_type_cd, '')) = #{value} AND COALESCE(info.deleted_yn, 'N') = 'N' AND COALESCE(sub_file.use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y' ) SELECT catalog_file.*, item_tree.tree_nm, parent_tree.tree_cd AS parent_tree_cd, parent_tree.tree_nm AS parent_tree_nm, effective_label.grade_cd, effective_label.grade_nm FROM catalog_file LEFT JOIN docs_sw_tree item_tree ON item_tree.tree_cd = catalog_file.tree_cd LEFT JOIN docs_sw_tree parent_tree ON parent_tree.tree_cd = item_tree.upper_tree_cd LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT label.grade_cd, grade_order.grade_nm FROM docs_file_security_label label LEFT JOIN docs_security_grade grade_order ON grade_order.grade_cd = label.grade_cd WHERE label.object_id = catalog_file.object_id AND ( (label.object_type = catalog_file.object_type AND label.file_no IN (catalog_file.file_no, '*')) OR (catalog_file.object_type = 'SW_SUB' AND label.object_type = 'SW' AND label.file_no = '*') ) ORDER BY grade_order.grade_level DESC NULLS LAST, CASE WHEN label.object_type = catalog_file.object_type AND label.file_no = catalog_file.file_no THEN 0 WHEN label.object_type = catalog_file.object_type AND label.file_no = '*' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END LIMIT 1 ) effective_label ON TRUE ORDER BY catalog_file.material_no, catalog_file.material_name, catalog_file.object_id, CASE WHEN catalog_file.object_type = 'SW' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, catalog_file.file_no LIMIT 500
SELECT FROM docs_distribution_request request_row WHERE request_row.request_id = #{value} FOR UPDATE OF request_row

SELECT request_item.item_id, request_item.request_id, request_item.line_no, request_item.document_line_no, request_item.file_line_no, request_item.object_type, request_item.object_id, request_item.file_no, request_item.material_no, request_item.material_name, request_item.original_file_name, request_item.file_size, request_item.grade_cd, grade.grade_nm, COALESCE(NULLIF(document_info.tree_cd, ''), NULLIF(document_info.business_type_cd, '')) AS tree_cd, item_tree.tree_nm, parent_tree.tree_cd AS parent_tree_cd, parent_tree.tree_nm AS parent_tree_nm, TO_CHAR(request_item.snapshot_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS snapshot_at FROM docs_distribution_request_item request_item LEFT JOIN docs_sw document_info ON document_info.object_id = request_item.object_id LEFT JOIN docs_sw_tree item_tree ON item_tree.tree_cd = COALESCE(NULLIF(document_info.tree_cd, ''), NULLIF(document_info.business_type_cd, '')) LEFT JOIN docs_sw_tree parent_tree ON parent_tree.tree_cd = item_tree.upper_tree_cd LEFT JOIN docs_security_grade grade ON grade.grade_cd = request_item.grade_cd WHERE request_item.request_id = #{value} ORDER BY request_item.document_line_no, request_item.file_line_no, request_item.line_no

SELECT recipient_id, request_id, line_no, partner_company_id, partner_user_id, user_name, email, phone, representative_yn FROM docs_distribution_request_recipient WHERE request_id = #{value} ORDER BY line_no, recipient_id

SELECT event_id, request_id, from_status, to_status, event_type, actor_user_cd, actor_user_id, actor_user_nm, event_comment, TO_CHAR(occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS occurred_at FROM docs_distribution_request_event WHERE request_id = #{value} ORDER BY occurred_at, event_id

SELECT FROM docs_distribution_request request_row JOIN docs_user actor ON actor.user_cd = #{actorUserCd} AND actor.use_yn = 'Y' AND actor.del_yn = 'N' AND COALESCE(actor.lock_yn, 'N') != 'Y' JOIN docs_user_security_clearance actor_clearance ON actor_clearance.user_cd = actor.user_cd AND actor_clearance.valid_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (actor_clearance.valid_to IS NULL OR actor_clearance.valid_to > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) JOIN docs_security_grade actor_grade ON actor_grade.grade_cd = actor_clearance.grade_cd AND actor_grade.use_yn = 'Y' JOIN docs_user_action_permission global_permission ON global_permission.user_cd = actor.user_cd AND global_permission.action_cd = 'VIEW' AND global_permission.allow_yn = 'Y' WHERE request_row.status = 'APPROVED' AND request_row.distribution_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM docs_distribution_request_item any_item WHERE any_item.request_id = request_row.request_id ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM docs_distribution_request_item candidate_item LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT label.grade_cd FROM docs_file_security_label label LEFT JOIN docs_security_grade grade_order ON grade_order.grade_cd = label.grade_cd WHERE label.object_id = candidate_item.object_id AND ( (label.object_type = candidate_item.object_type AND label.file_no IN (candidate_item.file_no, '*')) OR (candidate_item.object_type = 'SW_SUB' AND label.object_type = 'SW' AND label.file_no = '*') ) ORDER BY grade_order.grade_level DESC NULLS LAST, CASE WHEN label.object_type = candidate_item.object_type AND label.file_no = candidate_item.file_no THEN 0 WHEN label.object_type = candidate_item.object_type AND label.file_no = '*' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END LIMIT 1 ) effective_label ON TRUE LEFT JOIN docs_security_grade file_grade ON file_grade.grade_cd = effective_label.grade_cd AND file_grade.use_yn = 'Y' LEFT JOIN docs_object_user_permission document_permission ON document_permission.object_type = 'SW' AND document_permission.object_id = candidate_item.object_id AND document_permission.user_cd = actor.user_cd AND document_permission.action_cd = 'VIEW' WHERE candidate_item.request_id = request_row.request_id AND ( file_grade.grade_cd IS NULL OR actor_grade.grade_level < file_grade.grade_level OR document_permission.allow_yn IS DISTINCT FROM 'Y' ) ) ORDER BY request_row.updated_at DESC, request_row.request_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE docs_distribution_request SET title = #{request.title}, purpose = #{request.purpose}, partner_company_id = #{partner.partnerCompanyId}, partner_company_code = #{partner.companyCode}, partner_company_name = #{partner.companyName}, approver_user_cd = #{approver.approverUserCd}, approver_user_id = #{approver.userId}, approver_user_nm = #{approver.userName}, distribution_start_date = #{request.distributionStartDate}::date, distribution_end_date = #{request.distributionEndDate}::date, status = 'DRAFT', submitted_at = NULL, decided_at = NULL, decided_by_user_cd = NULL, decided_by_user_id = NULL, decided_by_user_nm = NULL, decision_comment = NULL, updated_by = #{actor.userCd}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version_no = version_no + 1 WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND status = #{expectedStatus}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT user_info.user_cd AS approver_user_cd, user_info.user_id, user_info.user_nm AS user_name, user_info.dept_cd, department.dept_nm FROM docs_user user_info JOIN docs_role_group_member membership ON membership.member_cd = user_info.user_cd AND membership.group_type = 'USER' JOIN docs_rel_role_group role_assignment ON role_assignment.group_cd = membership.group_code AND role_assignment.role_cd = 'ROLE_MENU_227' LEFT JOIN docs_dept department ON department.dept_cd = user_info.dept_cd WHERE user_info.use_yn = 'Y' AND user_info.del_yn = 'N' AND COALESCE(user_info.lock_yn, 'N') != 'Y' ORDER BY user_info.user_nm, user_info.user_id, user_info.user_cd

SELECT DISTINCT user_info.user_cd AS approver_user_cd, user_info.user_id, user_info.user_nm AS user_name, user_info.dept_cd, department.dept_nm FROM docs_user user_info JOIN docs_role_group_member membership ON membership.member_cd = user_info.user_cd AND membership.group_type = 'USER' JOIN docs_rel_role_group role_assignment ON role_assignment.group_cd = membership.group_code AND role_assignment.role_cd = 'ROLE_MENU_227' LEFT JOIN docs_dept department ON department.dept_cd = user_info.dept_cd WHERE user_info.user_cd = #{value} AND user_info.use_yn = 'Y' AND user_info.del_yn = 'N' AND COALESCE(user_info.lock_yn, 'N') != 'Y' LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE docs_distribution_request SET status = 'PENDING_APPROVAL', submitted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{actor.userCd}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version_no = version_no + 1 WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND status = #{expectedStatus} AND distribution_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE

UPDATE docs_distribution_request SET status = 'APPROVED', decided_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, decided_by_user_cd = #{actor.userCd}, decided_by_user_id = #{actor.userId}, decided_by_user_nm = #{actor.userNm}, decision_comment = NULLIF(#{comment}, ''), updated_by = #{actor.userCd}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version_no = version_no + 1 WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND status = #{expectedStatus} AND distribution_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE

UPDATE docs_distribution_request SET status = 'REJECTED', decided_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, decided_by_user_cd = #{actor.userCd}, decided_by_user_id = #{actor.userId}, decided_by_user_nm = #{actor.userNm}, decision_comment = #{comment}, updated_by = #{actor.userCd}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version_no = version_no + 1 WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND status = #{expectedStatus}

UPDATE docs_distribution_request SET status = 'CANCELLED', updated_by = #{actor.userCd}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version_no = version_no + 1 WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND status = #{expectedStatus}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO docs_distribution_request_event ( request_id, from_status, to_status, event_type, actor_user_cd, actor_user_id, actor_user_nm, event_comment ) VALUES ( #{requestId}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{eventType}, #{actor.userCd}, #{actor.userId}, #{actor.userNm}, NULLIF(#{comment}, '') )

INSERT INTO docs_distribution_outbox ( request_id, aggregate_id, event_type, status, payload_json ) SELECT request_row.request_id, request_row.request_no, 'DISTRIBUTION_APPROVED', 'HOLD', JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT( 'schemaVersion', 2, 'requestId', request_row.request_id, 'requestNo', request_row.request_no, 'status', request_row.status, 'title', request_row.title, 'purpose', request_row.purpose, 'distributionPeriod', JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT( 'startDate', request_row.distribution_start_date, 'endDate', request_row.distribution_end_date ), 'partner', JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT( 'partnerCompanyId', request_row.partner_company_id, 'companyCode', request_row.partner_company_code, 'companyName', request_row.partner_company_name ), 'recipients', COALESCE(( SELECT JSONB_AGG( JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT( 'lineNo', recipient.line_no, 'partnerUserId', recipient.partner_user_id, 'userName', recipient.user_name, 'email', recipient.email, 'phone', recipient.phone, 'representativeYn', recipient.representative_yn ) ORDER BY recipient.line_no ) FROM docs_distribution_request_recipient recipient WHERE recipient.request_id = request_row.request_id ), '[]'::jsonb), 'requestedBy', JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT( 'userCd', request_row.requested_by_user_cd, 'userId', request_row.requested_by_user_id, 'userName', request_row.requested_by_user_nm, 'deptCd', request_row.requested_dept_cd, 'deptName', request_row.requested_dept_nm ), 'approvedBy', JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT( 'userCd', request_row.decided_by_user_cd, 'userId', request_row.decided_by_user_id, 'userName', request_row.decided_by_user_nm ), 'assignedApprover', JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT( 'userCd', request_row.approver_user_cd, 'userId', request_row.approver_user_id, 'userName', request_row.approver_user_nm ), 'approvedAt', TO_JSONB(request_row.decided_at), 'items', COALESCE( JSONB_AGG( JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT( 'lineNo', item.line_no, 'documentLineNo', item.document_line_no, 'fileLineNo', item.file_line_no, 'objectType', item.object_type, 'objectId', item.object_id, 'fileNo', item.file_no, 'materialNo', item.material_no, 'materialName', item.material_name, 'originalFileName', item.original_file_name, 'fileSize', item.file_size, 'gradeCd', item.grade_cd, 'snapshotAt', item.snapshot_at ) ORDER BY item.line_no ) FILTER (WHERE item.item_id IS NOT NULL), '[]'::jsonb ) ) FROM docs_distribution_request request_row LEFT JOIN docs_distribution_request_item item ON item.request_id = request_row.request_id WHERE request_row.request_id = #{value} AND request_row.status = 'APPROVED' GROUP BY request_row.request_id ON CONFLICT (request_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM docs_distribution_outbox WHERE request_id = #{value}
mapper.update: WITH expired_request AS ( UPDATE docs_distribution_request SET status = 'EXPIRED', updated_by = 'SYSTEM', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version_no = version_no + 1 WHERE status = 'APPROVED' AND distribution_end_date < CURRENT_DATE RETURNING request_id ), expired_event AS ( INSERT INTO docs_distribution_request_event ( request_id, from_status, to_status, event_type, actor_user_cd, actor_user_id, actor_user_nm, event_comment, occurred_at ) SELECT request_id, 'APPROVED', 'EXPIRED', 'EXPIRE', 'SYSTEM', 'SYSTEM', 'SYSTEM', 'Distribution period expired.', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM expired_request RETURNING request_id ) UPDATE docs_distribution_outbox outbox SET status = 'DEAD', last_error = 'Distribution period expired before release.' WHERE outbox.request_id IN (SELECT request_id FROM expired_event) AND outbox.status = 'HOLD'
